data.long_meaning: From the Greek name Διάκου (Diákou), meaning 'god, Zeus'. The name Diakou carries the meaning “God, Zeus” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Greek. Parents who choose Diakou usually hope their child will grow to embody god, zeus and live with faith, good character and purpose.
